title: Overall review before the loop builds on master: read the specs, roadmap, QUESTIONS, architecture and the code they describe, and compare what is claimed done with what the code and tests do. Output docs/loop/reviews/2026-11-01.md (findings with file:line evidence, by severity: correctness, contract drift between specs and code, security, missing or unrun acceptance tests, dead or duplicated code) and one queue item per actionable finding, deduplicated against the queue and inserted after RQ-000 in priority order. Also correct stale items: RQ-031 and RQ-033 are blocked on a hosting decision that Q64 and M7a (spec 12) have since made. No product code changes.

Read KO's whole character-create flow and write it down as the contract for RQ-002..RQ-008: the nations and, per nation, the race/class matrix the 1298 create screen offers (which race buttons and class buttons, which are disabled, e.g. Puri Tuarek), face and hair ranges per race, the bonus points (total, per-stat floor and ceiling, each race/class's base stats and where they come from), KO's class description texts, the name rules and every refusal text, the confirm flow; and Ebenezer's side: the create packet's fields and the server's validation (name, stat sum, race/class/nation consistency, slots), the starting stats, items, zone and position per race/class. Source (ref/ko-src GameProcCharacterCreate.cpp, UICharacterCreate, GameProcNationSelect) and the 1298 client and Ebenezer binaries via the Ghidra setup; label evidence binary/source/local-asset with addresses. Output: content/character-create.md and the decisions it needs.

CreateCharacter carries what KO's create packet does (nation, race, class, face, hair, the stat points) and the Characters list carries each character's nation, race, class, face, hair and visible equipment; the server validates against package rules from RQ-001 (never trusting the client's stats), persists them (a migration, Postgres authoritative), and refuses in KO's wording. Wire goldens, spec 02/03 updates, server tests.

Package data for every KO race and class the create screen offers: each race's player model (UPC_DefaultLooks rows, cooked as ko_player does the Tuarek today), each class's base stats, starting items and weapons, skills set and class rules, as game data under games/moradon (no ids in engine modules). Today only the male Tuarek priest exists (ko_player.py RACE = 2).

KO's create screen with every option working, as 1298 draws it: race and class buttons (the nation's set, KO's disabled ones), face and hair arrows changing the model, bonus-point arrows with KO's counts and limits, KO's own class description texts (replacing the authored `class_desc` string), and the create model per race (InitChr per race; N3FE carries one model per race). Supersedes Q52's fixed race and class. Keep the screen original (no added UI).

The select hall draws each character as KO's AddChr does: its race/class joint, animation and plugs (the switch in GameProcCharacterSelect.cpp), and its own face, hair and equipment from the Characters list, instead of one Tuarek priest model for every slot; the info bar from its own race and class.

KO's nation selection (CGameProcNationSelect) for a new account, nation on the wire and in `characters`, and the El Morad select hall (el_chairs.n3shape, el lights) and its loading art; Q51 lifted. Server rules for nation (which zones, which races).

In-world play for every race and class created in RQ-004: the player model per race in the world, class weapons and skills, class stat rules on the server. Split into one item per class once RQ-001 and RQ-003 say what each needs.

KO's character deletion (Q53): bt_delete and KO's confirmation and rules as 1298/Ebenezer apply them, on a durable, auditable server path (soft delete, grace period, what happens to items), audited like the admin API.

Confirm in the 1298 binary what b637b01 took from KO's source only, and fix any divergence: the create screen's model (InitChr from UPC_DefaultLooks, InventoryChrAnimationInitialize -> ANI_BREATH, no plugs); the select hall at rest (every character on pre_select's first frame, the front one playing it while the pointer is in the centre rect 0.36-0.64 x 0.44-0.86, the dummy clip) and IsAnimEnd on selection; UI point sampling (CUIManager::RenderStateSet) and CN3UIImage::SetVB's integer rects; CN3Eng's trilinear filter, mip LOD bias -1 and wrap addressing. Record addresses.

The create screen's character view uses an invented camera (at y .95, eye (0, 1.1, -3.4), fov .75), one directional light and ambient .3, and does not turn; read InventoryChrRender/Tick in source and the binary (camera, lights, the model's rotation, any input that turns it) and match it.

Compare the Karus select hall with 1298: large regions draw pure black (left and right walls, the shape in front of the thrones) - missing geometry (does 1298 also load ChrSelect/ka_cave.n3shape or other parts?), lighting, fog or ambient; the camera turn speed and the spot's widening (KARUS_INCRESE_OFFSET, KARUS_THETA_MAX), AniCurSet blends (0.6 s to selected), the selected character's fade to loading. Match what differs.

Strings on KO screens that we wrote rather than KO: `select_info` ("Level: {level}\nSpecialty: {class}\nID: {name}"), `select_hint` ("Press ENTER to create a character."), `loading_info` ("Loading..."), `version` ("Ver. {version}"), `class_desc` ("... Every character in this realm is a Tuarek priest."). Find what 1298 shows in each place (its text resources and UIF strings) and use KO's, or show nothing where KO shows nothing (Q61: the screens stay original).

The screens draw text with Liberation Sans (regular, bold) as a substitute. Find the faces and sizes 1298 asks for (CDFont, the UIF font names) and decide how to get KO's look: a metric-compatible free font, the player's installed font, or a cooked bitmap of a licensed font. Record what is legal to ship.

Login screen details still unverified: which logo texture 1298 actually loads for Img_Daum/Img_MGame (the UIF names ui_us\\service_logos.dxt, the tree has Service_Logos_us.DXT) and whether the US client shows them; when KO shows `premium` and the three Group_Notice panels (hidden now); the ID field's focus and caret at rest; ESC and Cancel behaviour. Keep the inert ID/PW fields (Q60).

Confirm the login intro against CGameProcLogIn_1098 in the binary: camera, lights 0-2, the character's clip and loop, the moon quad's placement and scale, and the server list's drop-in speed (CUILogIn_1098::Tick).

KO's loading flow vs ours: which loading art per nation and zone, what the progress bar tracks and when, the version text and its format, and how long it stays after the world is ready (ours: 2/3 at start, 1 at the first World, held 0.4 s).
KO's intro and select music on the front-end screens (Q57) with a bounded stream (the tracks are minutes long), from the player's own KO files.

Q62 took 1024x768, 1280x1024 and 1600x1200 from tools/play-moradon. Read 1298's resolution list and fullscreen handling (Option.exe, the registry, the client's device setup), and how 1298 lays out UIF screens above 1024x768: we scale the 1024x768 canvas uniformly, but KO may draw its UI at 1:1 and reposition it. Match what KO does for the front end and the HUD.
Recut the 1097 --features bake pin (tests/ko_bake_pin.py, still dc494e1f...): every front-end change since M4c moved it, and the 1097 install was not on the machine that made them.
n3e-server is not rustfmt- or clippy -D warnings clean on master (pre-existing; CI gates only realm-launcher and realm-bot). Make it clean without behaviour changes and add it to the CI gate.

M5 (spec 06) up to publishing: the workflow (cron + workflow_dispatch(force)), server and bot images, the client builds, the Moradon content cooked from fetched KO assets, the manifest, Release + Pages, the headless make test gate. The ssh deploy is RQ-031.
M5's gated deploy over ssh: migrate, players-online check, drain, restart, tag, deploy:pending on skip; M6's /deploy done-when.
blocked_on: the host: this PC or a VPS; who hosts openko.net's DNS; public IPv4 (not CGNAT); where players are

title: M5b (spec 10): the content index and store in CD, registry kinds rate.*/event.active, events.json, spawn names, /v1/world/catalog and event routes, contributor docs and content CI checks; Q55's demo: id rename.
M7 (spec 07): the production host, the openko.net certificate and renewal hook, secrets per O5, nightly pg_dump off-box with a restore rehearsal, the rebuild runbook run once.
M8 (spec 08): docs on Pages.
Q54: a real server list (several realms with their population) behind a public status endpoint.

N3E_TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS: a mapped IPv6 range (::ffff:10.0.0.0/104) is canonicalised to IPv4 but keeps its /104 prefix, so the check computes 32 - 104 (a debug-build panic). Subtract 96 from a mapped range's prefix (refuse one under 96), as realm-edge does; add a connections_live case. Found while building spec 12.
